metadata.title: Clicked like a potato and somehow landed that 1 kill? Valorant’s just feeling generous!
metadata.description:
Me: brain on vacation, clicking like crazy
Enemy: probably uninstalling in disbelief
Valorant said ‘Here, take this kill, no questions’
Click if you’ve ever lucked out like this!

Tap if your aim’s a mystery but kills still happen!

#valorant #luckykill #gamingfails #funnygaming #shorts
